notes: P4.3 steady state, tick 20 ms, second pass with radio sampling on both ends. Radio via ubus/iwinfo: HaLow 924 MHz HT20 mesh, vehicle wlan1 (192.168.12.1) to pit wlan0 (192.168.12.201), peers pinned by MAC. Note iw misreports this link as 5805 MHz/160 MHz, so ubus is selected explicitly rather than auto. Vehicle wire counters are real nft named counters on :7422. Pit wire counters disabled deliberately: the pit stack runs inside the Docker Desktop VM, so leafnode bytes never cross the netfilter hooks of the host being sampled. Clock: NOT GNSS-traceable, the UM980 holds no fix so the fix-gated PPS is silent and chrony runs on holdover plus NTP. Run made from branch feat/p5.1-grafana-in-the-pit-stack (f5af3d0), which is main plus P5.1 docs and deploy changes touching neither src nor profiles; registry generation 4, identical to the earlier t20 and t10 runs.
